title: VIguard LAN Challenge Set Confidential Blind Human Review Attestation
reasonForRestriction: Human reviewers did not operate the public repository. Reviewer identities, worksheets, and source materials are retained in a restricted environment to prevent disclosure of confidential benchmark and operational information.

publicationClaims.allowedWording: The AI-assisted reference labels were subsequently confirmed through a confidential blind human review conducted outside the public repository; the review produced zero label changes.
publicationClaims.forbiddenWording: Publicly reproducible human ground truth or independently auditable raw human annotations.

temporalRelationship.reason: The byte content and SHA-256 of final-labels.jsonl did not change.

limitations: Reviewer identities and raw review artifacts are intentionally withheld from the public repository.
The public artifact is an operator attestation rather than a release of the confidential reviewer worksheets.
The dataset remains an authorized LAN challenge set and is not natural production traffic.
Human review confirmation does not make the labels infallible or universally generalizable ground truth.
